svg.text: 03 / Secondary wire cassette: rolling-loop calculation and exploded order
NOVA-LINK / B-RFQ / 2026-10-22 / mm / NOT RELEASED FOR MANUFACTURE
Neutral: two arcs + R7 reversing fold
Two independent axial wire lanes, no mains in cassette.
Add 10 mm clamped tail each end:249.34 mm.
Supplier dynamic bend qualification <=7 mm required.
No twist in ideal routing; motion test still mandatory.
Slots1.6 / divider0.8; seal divider/covers at B19 sleeve.

EXPLODED ASSEMBLY ORDER / corresponding STEP is spatially exploded
Lock ring / pin remain independent of the mains path. Assemble at keyed neutral; verify both stops before closing.
Supplier components shown as envelopes. Verify actual footprints, latch approach, harness and fixture CAD before tooling.
See canonical design for tolerances, assembly requirements, release gates and primary-source links.
